evidence.observation: close-results.md states: "RP3: 5 rounds, plus 2 attempts with no verdict (provider flag). The last repair has no second reader." The cited record 004-phase-RP3.md lists exactly six review directories (phase-RP3-r1 through r6) and its Review section assigns verdicts to only four rounds: r1 ("CHANGES_REQUESTED, four findings"), r2 ("two findings"), r3 ("one finding") and r5 ("one finding"), while r4 and r6 are the two "ended without a verdict" attempts. The accurate statement is 4 verdict rounds plus 2 no-verdict attempts; "5 rounds" overcounts by one. The second sentence ("The last repair has no second reader") is consistent with the record's note that the r5 repair is "verified by its regression test and the lanes above, not by a second reader."

concerns.recommendation: Correct the RP3 line in close-results.md to "4 rounds, plus 2 attempts with no verdict" or otherwise reconcile the count with 004-phase-RP3.md's r1-r6 review accounting.
concerns.title: close-results.md overstates RP3 review rounds: 5 claimed, 4 in the cited record

summary: All three artifacts hash to the request digests. Goal predicates RP1-RP5 each have executed-gate evidence in phase records 002-006 (quoted gate outputs and named oracle tests, all of which exist); spot-checks of src/gnd/export/pyrel_rules.py (_external_uniqueness, _ANCHORED_REASON, _EXACT_FLOAT=2**53, _refuse_binary_context, _refuse_inexact_head, cell_type, _universe), src/gnd/commands/export.py (success line) and docs/runtimes/pyrel.md (per-target not-checked/refusal statements and verbatim message list) match what close-results.md and close-delta.md claim, and plan section 11 amendments A1-A7 are each supported by the record that raised them with prior wording kept.
